name: Miska Deska
source:
The subordinate of Damon, an army officer of the Wisla Republic; she has been at his side even before she joined the military. Her petite frame and cute looks hide a much darker personality, but the moment she opens her mouth, her true evil nature rears its ugly head.

Miska tends to Damon's personal needs, but as everything she cooks turns into ash, which often leaves him disappointed. Her hobbies include sharpening the knives she's taken from her prey, as well as taking apart and putting together things that put up a good resistance to her blade.

Currently, she is entrusted with intelligence gathering. This is not because she is weak, but because she attacks indiscriminately, causing injury to her allies as well.

[From Frontwing's [url=https://www.facebook.com/FrontwingINT/photos/a.1633584283526141.1073741829.1633299420221294/1713715418846360/?type=3]official Facebook page[/url]]
